program.source: export function evaluate({ inputs, time, seed, state }) { const launchSpeed = inputs.launchSpeed; const gravity = inputs.gravity; const apexTime = launchSpeed / gravity; const apexHeight = (launchSpeed * launchSpeed) / (2 * gravity); const t = time; const tossedHeight = launchSpeed * t - (gravity * t * t) / 2; const tossedVelocity = launchSpeed - gravity * t; const tossedAcceleration = -gravity; let dropHeight = apexHeight; let dropVelocity = 0; let dropAcceleration = 0; if (t >= apexTime) { const dt = t - apexTime; dropHeight = apexHeight - (gravity * dt * dt) / 2; dropVelocity = -gravity * dt; dropAcceleration = -gravity; } let tossState = "At launch"; if (t > 0.05 && t < apexTime - 0.05) tossState = "Rising"; else if (Math.abs(t - apexTime) <= 0.05) tossState = "At the top"; else if (t > apexTime + 0.05 && tossedHeight > 0.05) tossState = "Falling"; else if (t >= apexTime + 0.05 && tossedHeight <= 0.05) tossState = "At launch height"; let dropState = "Held in place"; if (Math.abs(t - apexTime) <= 0.05) dropState = "Just released"; else if (t > apexTime + 0.05 && dropHeight > 0.05) dropState = "Falling together"; else if (t >= apexTime + 0.05 && dropHeight <= 0.05) dropState = "At launch height"; const objects = []; const width = 640; const height = 420; const scaleY = 130; const baseY = 360; const tossX = 180; const dropX = 460; objects.push(...sdk.panel({ x: 40, y: 30, w: 280, h: 370, title: "Toss lane", state: tossState, id: "lane.toss" })); objects.push(...sdk.panel({ x: 320, y: 30, w: 280, h: 370, title: "Drop lane", state: dropState, id: "lane.drop" })); objects.push(sdk.line("axis.toss", tossX, baseY, tossX, baseY - 2.2 * scaleY, { role: "neutral" })); objects.push(sdk.line("axis.drop", dropX, baseY, dropX, baseY - 2.2 * scaleY, { role: "neutral" })); const tossYPos = baseY - tossedHeight * scaleY; const dropYPos = baseY - dropHeight * scaleY; const gateYPos = baseY - apexHeight * scaleY; const gateOpen = t >= apexTime; objects.push(...sdk.gate("gate", dropX, gateYPos, { open: gateOpen, w: 40, label: "Apex gate" })); objects.push(sdk.circle("ball.toss", tossX, tossYPos, 26, { role: "output" })); objects.push(sdk.circle("ball.drop", dropX, dropYPos, 26, { role: "output" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.v.toss", { x: tossX - 25, y: tossYPos }, { value: tossedVelocity, direction: "up" }, { scale: 15, label: "v" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.a.toss", { x: tossX + 25, y: tossYPos }, { value: tossedAcceleration, direction: "up" }, { scale: 10, label: "a" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.v.drop", { x: dropX - 25, y: dropYPos }, { value: dropVelocity, direction: "up" }, { scale: 15, label: "v" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.a.drop", { x: dropX + 25, y: dropYPos }, { value: dropAcceleration, direction: "up" }, { scale: 10, label: "a" })); objects.push(...sdk.callout(tossX + 45, tossYPos - 20, ["v: " + sdk.format(tossedVelocity, 2) + " m/s", "a: " + sdk.format(tossedAcceleration, 2) + " m/s^2"], { id: "callout.toss" })); objects.push(...sdk.callout(dropX + 45, dropYPos - 20, ["v: " + sdk.format(dropVelocity, 2) + " m/s", "a: " + sdk.format(dropAcceleration, 2) + " m/s^2"], { id: "callout.drop" })); return { frame: { width, height, objects, readouts: [{ id: "tossedVelocity", value: tossedVelocity }, { id: "tossedAcceleration", value: tossedAcceleration }, { id: "dropVelocity", value: dropVelocity }, { id: "dropAcceleration", value: dropAcceleration }] }, quantities: { launchSpeed, gravity, apexTime, apexHeight, tossedVelocity, tossedAcceleration, tossedHeight, dropVelocity, dropAcceleration, dropHeight } }; }

manifest.title: Zero velocity isn’t zero acceleration.
manifest.summary: At the top, velocity is zero for an instant, but gravity keeps pulling: a = -g. A second ball is released then from rest, showing that both fall identically afterwards.
manifest.description: Two vertical lanes show a tossed ball and a dropped ball. At the top of the toss, velocity is zero but acceleration is -g, matching the start of the dropped ball.
assumptions: No air resistance, constant gravity, up is positive.
